Plays the music on this phone and on your own music server, and internet radio. It can also search, stream and download songs from YouTube Music.

Your library, playlists, queue, hearts and settings stay on this phone. A music server\'s password and a YouTube sign-in are sealed with a key in the phone\'s keystore before they are saved. Nothing is sent to the app\'s maker.

The app goes online only for what you use: your own music server (Navidrome or another Subsonic server) at the address you type in; YouTube Music, to search, stream and download, and, if you switch on Keep playing similar songs, to ask what plays next; radio.garden, to browse stations, and each station\'s own stream while it plays; and api.zippopotam.us, only for a US or Canadian postcode typed into the radio search. A server on a home network is often plain http, so what goes to it is not encrypted.

This app is free software under the GNU General Public License v3. It comes with no warranty: use it at your own risk. YouTube, radio stations and music servers are run by others, under their own terms.
